profile.name: Gulshan Kumar
profile.headline: Software Engineer & AI Developer
profile.intro: I'm a Software Engineering master's student at Blekinge Institute of Technology, with experience in full-stack development and a growing focus on AI engineering. I enjoy building practical solutions, from web applications to AI-powered tools, and exploring how new technologies can solve real-world problems.
about: I'm a software developer currently pursuing a Master's in Software Engineering at Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH), Sweden. I completed my Bachelor's in Software Development at Kristianstad University in 2025.

My work spans frontend development, backend systems, Android applications and applied AI. During my internship at Dun & Bradstreet, I worked with Angular and TypeScript, including accessibility-focused frontend development. I also built and deployed a consultancy website for a client.

Recently, I've been developing AI tools with retrieval-augmented generation, local language models and LangGraph. I enjoy following a problem from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing and deployment.

education.detail: Graduate studies in software engineering, quality, architecture and software evolution.
Graduated in June 2025. Thesis: Android intent security and inter-app communication.
Undergraduate studies before continuing my education in Sweden.

experience.details: Developed and deployed a multilingual consultancy website with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, including contact-form integration, responsive design and production hosting.
Worked with Angular, TypeScript and Angular Material, with attention to accessibility and frontend user experience.
Developed teamwork, time management and customer-service skills in a fast-paced workplace.
